beats.care: Cheap data is why you can stream, study and reel all day. The next goal is a billion 5G users by 2030.
beats.what: Telecom minister Jyotiraditya Scindia said one gigabyte of mobile data now costs about eight rupees, compared with 268 rupees in 2014.
beats.why: He spoke at India Mobile Congress, Asia's big telecom show, which wrapped up on 10 October.

cards.body: India has about 550 million 5G users now. Broadband users rose from 60 million in 2017 to over 1.1 billion. The Bharat 6G Alliance has 90 member institutions working on next-generation networks.

cards.note: Figures cited by the telecom minister.
cards.title: Price of 1 GB of mobile data

cards.body: India now makes about $63 billion worth of mobile phones a year, up from just $2–3 billion in 2014.

cards.why: A gigabyte fell from about ₹268 to about ₹8, putting the internet in almost everyone's pocket.
